readings.heading: Ὁ Ἀπόστολος — 1 Corinthians 3:9–17
verses: 9. Brothers and sisters: we are God's fellow workers, and you are God's field — God's building.
10. By the grace God gave me, I laid a foundation like a skilled master builder, and someone else is building on it. But each one should be careful how he builds.
11. Because no one can lay any other foundation than the one already laid — and that foundation is Jesus Christ.
12. If anyone builds on this foundation with gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, or straw,

13. each person's work will be shown for what it is. The Day of judgement will make it plain, because that Day is revealed with fire — and the fire will test what each person's work is really made of.
14. If what someone has built survives the fire, he will receive a reward.
15. If his work burns up, he will suffer the loss — he himself will be saved, but only like a man escaping through flames.
16. Don't you know that you are God's temple, and that God's Spirit lives in you?
17. If anyone destroys God's temple, God will destroy him. For God's temple is holy — and that temple is you.

readings.heading: Τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον — Matthew 14:22–34
verses: At that time, Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side of the lake, while he sent the crowds away. After he sent the crowds away, he went up the mountain by himself to pray. When evening came, he was there alone. But the boat was already far from land, battered by the waves, because the wind was against it.

Just before dawn — in the fourth watch of the night — Jesus came toward them, walking on the sea. When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they panicked. "It's a ghost," they said, and cried out in fear. But Jesus immediately spoke to them: "Take heart — it's me. Don't be afraid."

Peter answered him, "Lord, if it's you, command me to come to you on the water." "Come," he said. Peter climbed down out of the boat, walked on the water, and came toward Jesus. But when he saw the force of the wind, he was afraid, and starting to sink, he cried out, "Lord, save me!" Jesus immediately reached out his hand and caught him. "You of little faith," he said, "why did you doubt?"

And when they got into the boat, the wind stopped. Then those in the boat came and worshipped him, saying, "You really are the Son of God." And when they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
